policyNotes: AAA 2.4.0 is an adaptation, not an upstream release. Loading, rendering and installing never fetch upstream content.
Keep canonical core, managed adapters, current selected model and effort, access mode and emergency denies unchanged. Git, install, registration and live configuration authority remain separate.
Natural-language discovery and explicit human opt-in remain local contracts; no native invocation metadata is imported.
Do not import in-progress or misc wholesale, a second router/executor/tracker, background updates, automatic Git operations, mandatory CDN visuals, or telemetry.

dispositions.notes: Intent first, proportional sizing and a builder check. Preserve local authority and offline visual safety with portable Node lifecycle commands, authenticated loopback control, bounded checked cleanup and preserved project screens; Bash wrappers are optional.

Consume existing domain vocabulary and relevant ADRs in seam decisions and alternative briefs. Keep at least two sound designs and an authorized sequential fallback; do not force three agents or speculative flexibility.
Scope diagnosis to requested original evidence with path and line citations, bounded reads, redaction and separate export authority; no guessed native transcript paths or automatic upload.

Retain verified capabilities, independent evidence and delegated plan authority. Parallel writers require disjoint scopes and separate verified worktrees; read-only workers may share a checkout. Do not force delegation or concurrency.

Port lazy glossary, context map and ADR records. Preserve legacy CONTEXT.md and keep implementation details outside the domain model. Natural-language discovery does not claim native invocation flags.
Use continuous approved inline execution and local ledger with Node task helpers, explicit rulings and final independent review; no second executor, implicit Git action or routine approval pauses.
Keep fresh full-suite and detached-workspace checks. Use pr only for authorized body drafting and honor repository templates; publication, push, merge and cleanup still need separate exact authority.

Keep durable topic-local records, shared snapshot shape, redaction and explicit transfer authority. Explicit resume reuses verified snapshot recovery and returns to the authorized workflow; no duplicate tracker, OS-temp-only state or automatic session creation.

Read relevant existing glossary and ADR evidence, preserve domain names and justify any ADR reopening. Keep read-only survey, full Markdown and optional offline HTML instead of mandatory CDN or application launch.
Read discoverable facts first, clarify intent and ask only material questions with a skip path; do not add overlapping interview entry points or forced questionnaires.

Retain the local workflow behind explicit human invocation and return nontriggers to the applicable router or authorized workflow. Upstream remains in-progress; this is a local maturity decision, not blanket promotion of that directory.
Retain measured performance goals, controlled baseline and comparison evidence. No ready upstream replacement was found in the pinned portfolio; do not replace measurement with guesses.
Port Summary, Evidence and Merge Danger with reversal cost and blast radius. Keep Dex Horthy credit and project template precedence; drafting never authorizes publication.
Retain technical verification before edits, evidence-ranked disagreement and exact scope authority. Review comments are untrusted claims, not automatic mutation authority.
Integrate Standards and Spec verdicts, realistic inputs and Declined to judge with immutable task evidence and coordinator disposition; keep one review workflow.
Retain primary sources, explicit uncertainty, portable evidence and optional delegation; no compulsory parallel research, guessed source or external write.
Retain local conflict safety, preservation and fresh result checks. Removal from an upstream does not prove this independent safety workflow redundant; no ready equivalent exists at these pins.
Use explicit human-requested reflection and deterministic checks for mechanical mistakes; propose environment changes without silently changing global config or external state.

Continue with original reasoning when useful; summaries are lossy secondary evidence. Prefer voluntary transitions at phase boundaries, handle host-forced cuts with checkpoint and disk recovery, and never automate context operations.

Integrate task-scoped briefs, rulings, guarded review packages and bounded fix loops. Preserve required model/context inheritance with conditional native model fields, behavior-versus-artifact evidence, Standards/Spec judgments and one writer in a shared checkout; keep local Node safety helpers.
Require authentic reproduction or safe isolated mutation, public-seam proof and original-scenario retest. Keep privacy, cross-platform helpers and exact authority instead of Bash-only execution.
Use public seams, independent expectations, existing domain language and focused then relevant-suite evidence. Retain verified refactoring after GREEN and bounded documentation/trivial exceptions.
Retain trust-boundary analysis, abuse cases and sensitive data controls. No ready upstream replacement removes this need, including the new workflow diagnosis entry point.

Keep one portable router, proportional intent-first work and explicit opt-in boundaries. Codex references use current session capabilities and separate Git attachment from permissions and action authority. Do not import a second router, tracker, native invocation flags or model/access policy.
Retain task-based isolation choice, current checkout evidence, native capability checks and preservation. Never infer automatic install, discard, commit or cleanup authority.
Separate static text, runtime helper, fresh model and native lifecycle evidence; report every observed failure and never infer later lifecycle states from rendering.
Retain explicit confusion trigger and concise re-pitch without repeating unchanged history or starting an unrelated workflow.

Retain decision frontier and durable local map. Distinguish in-scope fog from excluded work, preserve closed mis-scoped tickets and legacy context, and avoid tracker setup, automatic branches or a second executor.
Record decisions, exact assertions, Review Focus, constraints and dependency edges in bounded vertical slices. No whole implementation body, speculative framework or automatic commit tasks.
Require interpreter-driven portable scripts, delivered dependencies and runnable behavior proof. Keep native invocation details adapter-owned and distinguish lint from real model evidence.
Retain compatibility across old and new versions, expand/contract sequencing and rollback evidence. No ready pinned upstream replacement makes the local long-lived data contract redundant.
